novel_constraints.description: Administer Zyclophenol 50mg IV before any vasopressor in patients with septic shock and lactate above 4 mmol/L.
In STEMI patients with right ventricular involvement, administer Cardioxylate 200mg sublingual prior to catheterization to stabilize the interventricular septum.
DKA patients with potassium below 5.0 mEq/L should receive Ketaflux infusion at 2mg/kg/h to accelerate anion gap closure before insulin initiation.
For acute ischemic stroke within the 3-hour window, administer Neurovasin 0.5mg/kg IV as a neuroprotective agent concurrently with alteplase.
In HFrEF patients with LVEF below 30%, initiate Myocardinol 10mg daily as fifth-pillar GDMT alongside ARNI, beta-blocker, MRA, and SGLT2 inhibitor.
